parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: PlanId
parameters.description:
The ID of the plan.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstancePlans](~~449398~~) operation to query the details of plans, including plan IDs.

parameters.name: PlanStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the plan. Valid values:

*   **disable**: disables the plan.
*   **enable**: enables the plan.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb set-db-instance-plan-status --plan-id 1234 --plan-status disable --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --region cn-hangzhou
